item_short_desc: Rothco’s MA-1 Bomber Backpack brings the iconic style of the classic MA-1 Bomber Jacket into a functional and fashionable bag. This backpack features a large main compartment with a double zipper, providing ample space for your essentials, whether you're heading to work, school, or on a day trip. The interior is lined with the recognizable orange lining that fans of the MA-1 jacket will appreciate, adding a touch of authenticity.
description: Rothco’s MA-1 Bomber Backpack brings the iconic style of the classic MA-1 Bomber Jacket into a functional and fashionable bag. This backpack features a large main compartment with a double zipper, providing ample space for your essentials, whether you're heading to work, school, or on a day trip. The interior is lined with the recognizable orange lining that fans of the MA-1 jacket will appreciate, adding a touch of authenticity. A front zippered compartment and an additional MA-1 flight jacket-inspired pocket ensure easy access to smaller items like your phone, keys, or wallet. The 2 side bottle holders with elastic tops keep your water bottles secure and within reach. Designed for both function and fashion, this backpack measures 15 inch x 13.5 inch x 7 inch, offering plenty of storage while maintaining a sleek, stylish look. Whether you're using it for your daily commute or as a versatile travel companion, the MA-1 Bomber Backpack is a standout choice for any occasion.
